name: Survival pressure and recovery window
summary: Survival tension needs alternating pressure and recovery so scarcity changes decisions without keeping the player in one permanently degraded state.
player_action: The player spends, conserves, searches, retreats, or risks danger to recover capability.
system_response: The game applies bounded attrition, exposes recovery opportunities, and prevents either endless abundance or an unrecoverable downward spiral.
failure_modes: One mistake creates an unrecoverable run long before death.
Safe rooms remove all route tension.
Random supply determines success more than planning or execution.
accessibility: Expose resource state and recovery options through multiple channels.
Provide bounded assist options without secretly changing save or reward identity.

smallest_playable_test.setup: A twenty-minute route with two pressure peaks, one uncertain search branch, one safe recovery window, fixed minimum supply, and seeded bonus supply.
smallest_playable_test.retain_if: Players alter routes and spending, recover from ordinary mistakes, and still fear entering pressure peaks unprepared.
smallest_playable_test.revise_if: Tension works but one resource or safe route dominates.
smallest_playable_test.reject_if: Accepted seeds soft-lock survival or scarcity changes only waiting and search time.
